name: Berlin Bike Tour
shortDescription: A guided tour to explore Berlin's highlights on a bike

departure.instructions: Meet your guide at the Fat Tire Tours office, located near the base of the Fernsehturm Tower in Alexanderplatz.

uniqueSellingPoints: Chance to explore Berlin's major attractions
Photo opportunities to capture scenic sights
Insights into the city's history and traditions
additionalInfo:
A light jumper or a rain jacket are recommended. All bikes are equipped with racks to place your jacket on.

Please bring your ticket with you to the attraction.

Be aware that operators may cancel for unforeseen reasons.

You need to be 18 years or older to book or be accompanied by an adult.
description:
On this tour, you’ll get the opportunity to take a bike ride around Berlin and explore some of the city’s major attractions with a local guide.

Before setting off, you’ll meet your guide in Alexanderplatz and listen to stories related to Berlin’s culture and long history. You’ll then head to Marx-Engels-Platz and the Palace of the Republic, where you’ll be able to learn about the origins of the German Democratic Republic. You’ll ride around the Museum Island, stop at Checkpoint Charlie and Berlin Wall and discover Potsdamer Platz.

Besides, you’ll have the chance to explore such historic attractions as the Führerbunker, the Brandenburg Gate, the Victory Column and the Gendarmenmarkt. You’ll also be able to explore the scenic area along the Spree and ride through the Tiergarten.
